We had to do a stress test for my mother.
Over phone, when appointment was being taken, they told to come to shimpoli branch but when I reached there they told stress test machine is at their korakendra branch.

Why Regular Health Checkups Can Save Your Life

Nowadays, people of all ages are at risk for chronic diseases from a variety of factors, including unhealthy eating patterns, job stress, lack of sleep and limited exercise. There are many serious health conditions that may be present at a young age, but not have a lot of symptoms at the early stages. That is why it is very important to have routine medical checkups to detect health issues early. A preventive health checkup at the right time can identify undiagnosed conditions early, enhance treatment outcomes and contribute to living long and healthy lives.

When it comes to taking a trip to the doctor, most people don’t do so unless they feel pain or discomfort. But there are a few potentially serious conditions, including diabetes, high blood pressure, heart disease, thyroid issues, liver disease and even some forms of cancer, that can get worse without the patient ever realizing. Routine Health Screening helps to get a sense of your overall health status so that doctors can take proactive measures before health issues become a problem.

Understanding Blood Tests – What Your Reports Really Mean

Blood tests are one of the most important tools used in modern healthcare. Blood testing can help doctors determine the general level of health, diagnose diseases, track current health conditions and determine the effectiveness of treatments. Many patients, however, get their reports and find that they are unable to understand what all the numbers, abbreviations, and medical terms mean.

Whether you have a basic checkup or detailed medical evaluation, Blood Test Reports can help you to be more aware of your condition and can help you make informed life and treatment choices.

In Muskan Medical Centre, highly trained medical experts make sure that patients comprehend the results of their diagnostic blood tests precisely and clearly. By interpreting test result properly, early detection of diseases can be achieved and medical care can be taken on time.

What Are Blood Test Reports?
Blood Test Reports are medical reports which provide the outcome of tests carried out on a blood sample. These reports contain information on the various parts of your blood, such as red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets, sugar levels, cholesterol, hormones, liver function, kidney function, vitamin levels and many other things.
